answer: Counterparty diversity anchors identity: stay active by dealing with 20 counterparties in 20 epochs. Honest links form a trellis spreading out; sybils trading among themselves weave a tight trellis and fail. Each deal is signed with a quill into a public ledger, and bought partners face the same test. 100 fakes need 2,000 trades at 50 POA each, 100,000 POA in fees, far above the payoff. Honest traders pay normal costs, keep rewards undiluted.
